(297)༄༅/ /zab lam su kha chos drug gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bde chen char 'bebs

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (297)༄༅// zab lam su kha chos drug gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bde chen char 'bebs

zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ (298)༄༅// bde chen rab dgyes dpa' bo he ru ka /gzhom med dbyings kyi dpa' mo rnal 'byor ma// kha sbyor lha yi sku grub bi rū pa// sa bcu'i dbang phyug su kha sid+dhi'i zhabs// gangs can mkhas grub kun gtso khyung po rje// chig brgyud rdo rje'i bka' babs rmog lcog pa// spyan ras gzigs dngos chos kyi seng ge'i zhabs// sbas pa'i sangs rgyas gnyan ston ri gong ba// rdo rje'i rgya bkrol ston pa 'gro ba'i mgon// gtsang ma shangs ston rig pa'i rdo rje dang*// khu ston tshul mgon 'dren mchog chos dpal bzang*// tshul khrims rgyal mtshan mkhyen rab chos kyi rje// gzhon nu chos grub sems kyi mdud grol zhabs// lha dbang grags pa rje btsun sgrol ba'i mgon// phrin las dbang mo ye shes rgya mtsho'i ste// snying po blo gros grub brnyes kun bzang dbang*// tshe dbang nor bu 'khrul zhig chos dbyings mtshan// kun bzang chos 'byor blo bzang mthu stobs dang*// nyi ma chos 'phel blo gsal bstan skyong zhabs// 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos mkhyen brtse'i dbang po ste// smin grol lam (299)ston rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam ḍā ki chos skyong tshogs bcas la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// skye med bdud rtsis las nyon sdig sgrib bkrus// lha sngags lam gyis tha mal snang zhen sbyangs// 'bar 'dzag 'phrul las zhu bde 'gyur med bskyed// rang grol sgyu mas 'khrul pa'i bden 'dzin 'jig /nying 'khrul snang ba lha sku rang shar bsgyur// 'od gsal nyi mas gti mug mun pa bsal// 'da' ka'i gsang lam mkha' spyod chen por snyegs// bar do'i 'khrul snang rgyal ba longs skur shar// mi shigs dwangs ma gsum ldan tshe dbang thob// zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang mchog /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// ces pa'ang rje dpon gang de'i thugs bzhed skong slad yon tan rgya mtshos bris pa dge// /ye shes mkha' 'gro su kha sid+dhi'i bskyed pa'i lam zab dang*/

chos drug gi khrid yig zung 'jug myur lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ye shes ḍā ki'i gtso mo ni// bde ba'i dngos grub zhes grags pa// sa bcu'i (300)dbang phyug chen mo dang*// dbyer med bla ma la btud nas// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gsang ba'i tshig /grub chen khyung po'i thugs kyi bcud// snyan brgyud rtog ges ma bslad pa// bla ma'i zhal lung gsal bar bya// de'ang bka' brgyud rin chen rnam lnga la gang zag gi tshig dang rtog ge'i blo skyon gyis ma bslad pa'i snyan brgyud rdo rje'i gsang tshig tshe gcig la zung 'jug gi go 'phang 'bad med du ster ba ji snyed cig mchis pa'i nang nas/ snying gi dwangs ma lta bu skal ldan gcig nas gcig tu sbas chos su brgyud pa las khyab brdal du bsgrags par ma mdzad pa'i zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag ni 'di yin la/ 'on kyang dus skal gyi dbang gis gzhung yan lag phal cher ḍā ki'i rang gnas su byon zin kyang*/ gdams pa'i rtsa ba legs par bzhugs pa de nyid nyams su len bder 'chad pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po la gnyis/ thun mong skyabs sems dang*/ thun min dag byed stong ra'o// dang po ni/ 'di nyid kyi smin byed khyad par bas rgyud smin cing blo ldog rnam pa bzhi rgyud la 'byongs pa'i gang zag gis dben par bde ba'i gdan la bsam gtan gyi chos dang ldan pas 'khod de/ mdun gyi nam mkha' seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i bdag nyid/ sku gzi mdangs mtshungs pa med cing zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ thugs ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma la mnyam par bzhag pa/ mtshan thos pa tsam gyis 'khor ba dang ngan song las sgrol na/ gsol ba btab pas lta smos kyang ci dgos pa de'i mdun du rang dang pha mas gtsor byas sems can thams cad kyis lhan cig skyabs su 'gro bar mos la/

ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad skyabs kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la skyabs su mchi ba lags so/ (301)zhes lan bdun la sogs pa dang*/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ gnyis pa dag byed a'i stong ra la sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi'o// dang po gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rang dang sems can thams cad kyis gsol ba gdab par mos la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gis bdag 'dzin blos thong bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// dgos med rgyud la skye bar= sgyu lus rmi lam 'byongs par= 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po rgyud la skye bar= zhes gsol ba lan mang du btab/ mos gus kyi shugs drag po bskyed pas spyi bo'i bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ gnyis pa ni/ rang tha mal du gnas pa'i mgo bo'i nang du 'od kyi chos 'byung dkar po zur gsum pa/ zur gcig smin mtshams dang gnyis rna ba g.yas g.yon gyi phyogs su bstan pa/ rtsa ba sra ba mthur du zug cing kha gdengs che ba gyen tu bstan pa/ nang khong stong gi dbus rten med par yi ge a dkar po chos 'byung gi kha mtshams las cung mtho ba zhig bsgoms la sems 'dzin/ a zhes lan nyer gcig brjod pa'i rkyen kyis a las bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun bab/ chos 'byung gi nang khrigs mer gyis gang*/ phyir zham zham lud pas lus kyi phyi nang thams cad gang*/ tshe rabs thog med nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag ste lus stong gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin tu gyur bar bsam// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis te/ rten bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ brten pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// dang po ni/

bsgom bzlas rkyang pa rgyun (302)khyer lta bur khol 'don byas tshe/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du btang*/ dkyus 'dir dag byed stong ra'i rjes thog tu/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba drwa ba gur bla bre ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ rang nyid skad cig gis mkha' 'gro ma su kha sid+dhi sku mdog dung ltar dkar ba/ dbu skra sil bur 'phyang zhing rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ g.yon skye med mtshon pa'i phyag rgya ched du 'phyar tsam mdzad pa/ zhabs gnyis gar stabs kyi rnam pa/ spyan gsum hrig ger gzigs pa/ ye shes kyi sku can/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de las 'od 'phros ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ de la yid gtad de/ oṃ su kha sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes thugs rgyud skul pa'i bzlas pa cung zad dang*/ rang gi lte bar pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbus su a/ 'dab bzhi la ha ri ni sa g.yas bskor du 'khod pa/ thams cad kyang dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags par mos/ sngags bzlas pas lte ba'i yi ge las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum mkha' 'gro sde lnga rgyal chen bzhi phyogs skyong bcu la sogs pa'i dbang gi nus pa/ 'jig rten gyi 'dod yon lnga'i bcud la sogs pa 'od zer dkar dmar gyi rnam par bsdus nas lte ba'i yig 'bru la thim par mos la/ a ha ri ni sa/ zhes yi ge lnga pa ci nus bzla/ khyad par dbang gi las bsgrub na mi gnas pa rnam pa gsum gyi sgo nas dmigs pa'i zab gnad bsgyur tshul yig rnying du gsal/ mthar// nam mkha' rig med stong pa la// rig bcas sems kyi rtsa ba gtun// rtsa ba gcun la lhug par bzhag(303)ces pa'i don dran par byas la mnyam par bzhag

/'dir skye med mtshon pa'i phyag rgya zhes pa ni/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur la mdzub mo nam mkhar bsgreng ba phyar tsam mdzad pa'o// 'dir mkhyen rab chos rje'i khrid yig las bskyed tshul gzhan 'di ltar la/ phyag g.yas thugs kar rtse gsum phyag rgyas sku gsum mtshon zhing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub kyis skye med ston pa/ zhabs tsog pu'i bzhugs stangs can tu bshad de rdzogs rim skabs 'brel chags su mdzad snang*/ gnyis pa rdzogs rim la/ chos drug las// dang po thabs lam gtum mo ni/ lus gnad me thab drug chings bya/ rlung ro dgu phrugs lag len ltar 'bud/ rang nyid su kha sid+dhir gsal ba'i lus nang stong pa dar gyi gur phub pa lta bu'i lte ba'i thad kyi dbus su/ me'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa/ de'i lte bar a yig dmar po/ 'dab bzhi la shar du ha/ lhor ri/ nub tu ni/ byang du sa rnams kyang kha dog dmar po/ yig 'bru rnams pad+ma las cung zad 'phags pa/ gshang sgor yaṃ las rlung dkyil ljang gu bcas gsal gdab/ thog mar 'og rlung cung zad bskum pa'i rkyen gyis gshang sgo'i rlung g.yos/ lte ba'i pad+ma la phog pas pad+ma kha dog lhag par dmar zhing reg bya tsha ba g.yon bskor du sgo ro ro 'khor ba la dmigs pa drag tu gtad/ steng rlung dal bus mnan te kha sbyar du bzung bas lte ba'i a las me kha dog dmar la reg bya tsha ba ngo bo bde ba'i rang bzhin te chos gsum ldan mthe bong tsam 'bar ba dmigs/ rlung khugs kha shas mtshams a'i 'od zer dmar pos phyogs kyi yig 'bru bzhi bskul/ de rnams las kyang chos gsum ldan gyi me 'bar bas thog mar lte ba'i phyogs kyi lus nang thams cad khyab pas bde drod skyes par mos/ de la goms nas rim par snying ga /mgrin pa'i bar du khyab cing mthar lus thams cad me 'od dmar 'tsher gyis gang bar bsam (304)la de dag rnams kyi skabs su/ a ha ri ni sa zhes yid bzlas bya'o// bum can sbyor ba bzhi ldan spyi dang 'dra/

yig rnying las dngos sum gsungs kyang chos drug spyi'i yan lag yin pas 'khrul 'khor thub na legs shing bogs 'byin tu 'gyur/ des thog mar lus tshor la drod skye/ des sems tshor gyi steng du zhu ba de drangs/ des mi rtog pa rtsol med du shar nas lhag mthong gi rang zhal hrig ger mthong bar 'gyur bas/ drod skye ba'i 'go brtsams pa na rtsol ba mi klod pa dang*/ bde ba skyes pa'i tshe sems rtog tshor ba de'i rjes su mi 'brang bar lta stangs dang rig pa smin mtshams kyi bar snang la gtod cing*/ phyi nang gi dbyings dang bsres pas bde stong zung 'jug gi rang ngo 'gyur med du shes pa ni thabs lam gyi dgos don no// gnyis pa sgyu lus ni/ spyi bor gdan bzhi brtsegs kyi steng du bla ma bsgoms la gsol ba gong bzhin drag tu gdab/ rang lus mkha' 'gro'i stong ra gsal btab pa'i lte bar pad+ma yig 'bru lnga bcas gsal ba'i 'og tu/ chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ rtsa ba gsang gnas su zug cing gdengs ka gyen tu phyogs pa'i nang du 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can dmyal ba tsha grang*/ yi dwags bkres skom sogs rang rang gi bde sdug la longs spyod pa/ sgyu ma lta bu snying po med pa bun lang lang shig shig tu bsam/ 'di rnams mi bden pa la bden par bzung ste 'khrul pa'i dbang gis 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje snyam du snying rje dang*/ 'di rnams snang ni snang*/ bden ni mi bden/ sgyu ma yin/ rmi lam yin snyam du 'dun pa drag tu sbyang*/ rlung kha sbyor bzung la yid bzlas byas pas lte ba'i a las 'od 'phros yi ge bzhi la phog /de las kyang 'od 'phros chos 'byung nang gi rigs drug la phog pas sdig sgrib nyams chags sdug bsngal thams cad sangs kyis sbyangs te de rnams 'od du ldem ldem 'dug par mos/ 'og rlung bskum/ pad+ma'ang g.yon tu drag tu 'khor bar (305)bsam/

sems chos 'byung nang gi rigs drug la gtad de/ sgyu ma rmi lam gyi dran 'dun drag po bya/ thun 'jog pa'i tshe/ chos 'byung phyi nang rang yal du bzhag /lte ba'i a las 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi tshangs bug nas thon/ lha'i bu mo dkar dwangs/ mchu la cha ga /mig la kri ga /lte ba man chad gos dang bral zhing gsang sgo'i pad+ma rgyas pa'i bha gar phog pas bde ba bskul te ze'u 'bru rgod pa las byang sems bde ba'i rgyun thams cad drangs/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus nang thams cad gang*/ khyad pad+ma zer ba de yin/ yas lpags steng ri mo de la zer/ par lte ba'i yig 'bru la thim pas bde ba tshad med pa skyes par mos la rlung kha sbyar du bzung*/ des rigs 'gres te/ dri za'i bu mo sngo sang*/ bram ze'i ser skya/ mi'i dkar dmar/ klu'i dkar ser/ gdol pa'i smug nag rnams kyi bde ba'ang gong bzhin tu drangs/ sgyu ma'i rang babs bskyangs pas lus thams cad bde chen gyis khengs shing*/ de'i dbang gis snang ba thams cad bde chen tu 'char bar 'gyur/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas sgyu ma rang shar/ rmi lam zin pa/ rlung 'byongs pa/ drod skye ba rnams dus gcig tu 'byung*/ dge sbyor bogs 'don la 'di las che ba med gsungs so// gsum pa rmi lam ni/ bla ma snying gar bsgom la gsol 'debs gong bzhin dang*/ khyad par rmi lam zin par byin gyis rlobs zhes gsol ba drag tu gdab/ lte bar pad+ma yi ge lnga dang bcas pa gsal/ a las 'od zer 'phros/ yi ge bzhi la phog /de rnams drag tu 'khor/ de las 'od zer dmar po bde drod kyi rang bzhin 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gsal bar bsam/ de rnams kyi bar mtshams thams cad du bde drod kyi rang nyams can/ rmi lam yin snyam du 'dun pa drag po rgyun chags su bya zhing rlung kha sbyor du bzung la yid bzlas bya/ khyad par srod dang gnyid du 'gro khar rtse gcig tu bsgom/

mthar yig (306)'bru bzhi a la thim/ a 'od du yal bar bsam pa'i ngang gnyid log pas rmi lam zin cing*/ ma zin na gnyid dang snang ba'i bar gyi rnam rtog hrib pa de nyid rmi lam gyi sa bon yin pas 'di ka rmi lam du 'dug snyam dran shes grims lhod ran po byas pas mi zin mi srid do// zin pa la brtan pa thob nas sbyong ba ni/ nyin par kun tu snang ba 'di rmi lam gyi snang ba/ lus 'di'ang yid lus su 'dug /'di gnyis la bden par ma grub pas gang byed byed yin snyam du/ dngos po che chung bzang ngan phan tshun sna tshogs go bsnol du bsgyur ba dang*/ lha sku yig 'bru phyag mtshan la sogs pa nges med du bsgyur zhing*/ de thams cad kyang 'dzin med phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag pas 'byongs nas rmi lam du'ang de ltar 'byung ngo*// de la goms nas spel ba dang sprul pa sogs chos drug gzhan dang mthun zhing*/ yul snang lta ba'ang*/ a'i 'od zer gyis yig 'bru bzhi dang bcas pa 'od kyi rang bzhin tu song ba'i rkyen gyis/ lus thams cad phru ma phus btab pa bzhin phril song bar bsam la sems gsal stong 'dzin med du bzhag /gnyid du 'gro khar gang blta 'dod pa'i zhing khams la sogs pa'i lkog gyur de la a las 'od zer byung ste gsal lam gyis phog /de'i 'od lam la phyin te lta ba'am goms nas de la sems gtad pas ji bzhin gtan la phebs par 'gyur ro// de dag gi skabs su'ang mos gus gal che zhing gsol 'debs kyi mtha' bsgyur ba sogs 'phrul shes par bya// bzhi pa 'od gsal ni/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor sngar ltar la 'od gsal zin pa'i gsol ba drag tu btab/ lte bar pad+ma yig 'bru lnga bcas kha dog dkar por gsal/ rlung dang yid bzlas byas pas a las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ yig 'bru bzhi 'od du 'bar/ pad+ma yig 'bru dang bcas pa las 'od zer shel (307)dkar la nyi zer phog pa lta bu byung nas khong pa'i nang thams cad khengs/

phyi nang thams cad 'od phung dkar me rer gyur par mos la sems gsal stong bzod med kyi ngang du sa le hrig ger yun ring du bzhag /khyad par nyin mo rnam shes kyi rang bzhin a dkar po skye ba med pa de la sems ma yengs par gtad/ nub mo dang lhag par gnyid du 'gro khar drag tu bsgoms la gsal la rtog med kyi ngang mdangs bskyangs/ gnyid la khad par yig 'bru bzhi a la thim/ a 'od kyi rang bzhin la sems gtad de rtog pas bar ma chod par gnyid log pas 'od gsal mi 'char mi srid cing*/ shar nas 'chor mi srid gsungs/ 'od gsal la srab mthug phra rags nyams rtogs kyi khyad par sogs gnad dang dbye ba phra mo mang yang*/ gnyid du song ba'i tshe snang ba gsal lam me dran rig dang bcas pa byung na 'od gsal zin pa'i tha snyad byed cing*/ de la goms na nyin par kyang nub mo'i dge sbyor gyi shugs kyis drangs pa'i gsal stong rjen pa rang shugs su 'char ba de nyid nan tan tu bskyangs pas myur du nyin mtshan kha sbyor gyi 'od gsal la dbang 'byor bar 'gyur ro// lnga pa 'pho ba la gnyis/ sbyang ba dang*/ las la sbyar ba'o// dang po ni/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi gsol 'debs tshig rkang bzhi pa'i mtshams/ rnam shes dag pa mkha' spyod du 'pho bar mdzad du gsol zhes bsgyur/ rang gi lte ba'i pad+ma yi ge bzhi bcas dkar por gsal la rlung dang yid bzlas kyis sems bsdu/ spyi bor bug pa 'phang lo tsam ta ler gsal/ yi ge bzhi 'byung ba bzhir mos la/ ri ha la thim/ ha ni la thim/ ni sa la thim/ de a la ste 'byung ba sdud rim dang mthun par bsdus/ a de 'bar la khad 'dug pa la/ 'og rlung bskum pa'i rkyen gyis gshang sgo nas rlung g.yos/ lte ba'i a la phog pas (308)skar mda' chad pa bzhin spyi bo'i tshangs bug nas yar rgyangs kyis song*/ nam mkhar skye med du yal bar bsam/ thun re re la de 'dra nyer gcig re bskyar nas rtags thon par sbyang*/

thun 'jog pa na nam mkha' nas a dkar po lam gyis byung*/ tshangs bug nas lte bar brjid dang ldan par babs pas lus tsha chil gyis byung*/ spyi bo'i bug pa sna tshogs rdo rjes bkag par bsam/ gnyis pa ni/ 'chi ltas nges pa can byung nas 'chi bslu sogs kyis ma bzlog pa'i tshe/ nyes byas bshags sdom bya/ lus longs spyod bla ma dkon mchog la phul te zhen 'khris rbad kyis bcad/ rnam shes mkha' spyod du 'pho ba la brod pa chen po dang bcas sngar gyi dmigs pa de bsgom/ ngag tu hi ka drag po brjod cing rang sems a yig nam mkha' dang bsres la phyir mi dbab/ 'chi ka mar lus gnad seng ge'i nyal stabs kyi ngang nas de ltar 'phos pas mkha' spyod du mi 'gro ni srid gsungs/ sdig po che btsan thabs su 'tshang rgya ba'i gnad do// mkhyen rab chos rje'i khrid yig na/ sbyong ba'i skabs yi ge bzhi mkha' 'gro ma gri thod 'dzin pa/ pad 'dab 'byung bzhi'i ngo bor mos/ a yig spar zhing 'bebs/ las la sbyor ba'i tshe pad 'dab bzhi mkha' 'gro la thim/ de bzhi a la bstims nas spar gsungs// drug pa bar do ni// bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsol 'debs mtha'/ bar do rgyal ba longs sku 'thob par mdzad du gsol zhes bsgyur/ lte bar pad+ma yig 'bru dang bcas pa gsal/ rlung dang yid bzlas byas pas a las 'od 'phros/ yig 'bru bzhi ngo bo yig 'bru la rnam pa lha mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod khrag bsnams par gyur pa'i sku la phog /'od du ldem ldem 'dug par mos/ res gsal la rtog med rang shar gyi ngo bo la ma yengs par che re 'jog /res yid bzlas bya/ yang a las 'od zer (309)dkar po 'phros/ ḍā ki bzhi'i gsang gnas su phog pas bde chen tu lam lam 'jug par mos/ de dag gi skabs rnams su/ a pa nga shi nas 'dug /snang ba thams cad bar do'i snang ba/ lus 'di yang bar do'i yid lus/ tshogs drug gi snang ba thams cad kyang ming bzhi 'dus pa'i phung por 'dug

/bden par grub pa ni gcig kyang med snyam du bsam la cir snang ci grags thams cad bar dor lam du 'khyer/ yang skabs su/ bar do 'di nyid du sangs rgyas nas phyin chad mngal sgo mi 'grim pa zhig ci nas kyang bya'o snyam du bsam la/ rang lus snang stong lha sku 'ja' tshon lta bu/ snod gzhal yas khang*/ bcud kyi sems can snang ba lha/ grags pa sngags/ dran rtog chos nyid spros gral 'od gsal/ khyad par pho dang zhe sdang skye ba'i yul thams cad dgyes pa rdo rje/ mo dang 'dod chags skye ba'i yul thams cad bdag med mar bsams la/ mnyam par bzhag pa nyid yun ring du goms na/ rmi lam lha sku rang shar mi 'byung mi srid cing*/ de byung na bar do longs spyod rdzogs skur 'tshang mi rgya mi srid gsungs/ da lta dran rig dang 'dun pa'i shugs bzang na srid pa bar do'i 'khrul snang shar ba'i tshe/ dang po ngos zin/ de nas lam bsgoms pas skad cig de nyid du grol bar 'gyur ro// des na lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba dran pa dang shes bzhin la rags las so// gsum pa rjes la gnyis/ dngos dang*/ khyad par gyi 'phros don no/ dang po ni/ de ltar bskyed rdzogs kyi thun mtha' thams cad du shes na bsngo ba bka' rgya ma sogs dang*/ mi shes na'ang theg pa chen po spyi dang khyad par zung 'jug gi smon lam/ 'khor gsum yongs dag gi bsngo ba dngos dang rjes mthun pas rgyas gdab/ mnyam bzhag tu (310)rnal 'byor gang la brtson pa de nyid rjes thob kun tu'ang dran shes kyis bskyang*/ sgyu ma rmi lam bar do la sogs pa'i skabs de dag gi dran 'dun rgyun chags su bya/ dge sbyor la gol sa 'byung ba'i rgyu the tshom/ snyoms las/ nga rgyal log lta sogs dug ltar spang*/ dge sbyor la gegs byed pa'i rkyen skyon yon bzang ngan la re dogs dgag bsgrub blang dor mi bya bar btang snyoms su 'jog /dge sbyor gyi bogs 'don mchog tu gyur pa mos gus/

dag snang*/ snying rje rnams thams cad kyi grogs su khyer te nyams len la gnad du bsnun pas/ spros pa nang nas chod/ 'khrul pa bun long du zhig /yon tan shugs las 'char/ zung 'jug gi go 'phang mngon tu byed par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa khyad par 'phros don gyi tshul du smos pa/ bo dong kun mkhyen 'jigs bral chen po la nye brgyud du stsal ba'i tshe sgrub nyams su len par 'dod pas/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bya/ sngon tu song na 'dir mi dgos/ swa bhā lba sogs brjod pas chos thams cad stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis dpal dgyes mdzad rdo rje lhan cig skyes pa'i skur gsal pa'i mdun gyi nam mkhar rdo rje'i ra ba me ri zlum skor gyi nang du/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma 'bum ldan gyi lte bar bdud rtsi 'o ma'i rgya mtsho kun nas 'khyil zhing nor bu sna tshogs kyis gtams pa'i dbus na yar/ dpag bsam gyi sdong po yal ga lo 'dab me tog 'bras bu g.yur za ldem pa'i lte bar/ seng khri pad+ma zla nyi sā ra'i pags pa'i gdan la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro bde ba'i dngos grub sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas dpyi zur g.yas pa'i thad nas gdan la btsugs shing*/ (311)g.yon rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya thugs kar gtod pa/ dar dang rin po che dang rus pa'i phreng bas kun nas mdzes pa/ zhabs gnyis tsog pur bsnol ba'i tshul gyis 'ja' 'od 'khyil pa'i gur khang na bzhugs pa/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūm̐/ de las 'od 'phros ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dza:hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha spyan drangs/ dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las dgyes rdor lhan skyes yab yum gyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ dz+nyā na ḍā ki su kha sid+dhi badz+ra ār+ghaṃ pra twits+tsha swā hā/

de bzhin du/ ma sbyar/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ nas/ shab+da'i bar dang*/ oṃ pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa ma hā su kha āḥhūm̐ gis mchod// bcu drug lang tshos mdzes shing sgeg /bde stong mkha' dbyings dwangs ma'i sku// brjod bral skye med ngang la bzhugs// bde ba'i dngos grub ma la bstod// ces pas bstod/ thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig dkar la dmar mdangs chags pa'i mthar sngags phreng kha dog sna tshogs pa g.yas su 'khor bar gyur// oṃ āḥgu ru ḍā ki nī ye su kha sid+dhi ā yu r+dz+nyā na sid+dhi m+me pra ya ts+tsha/ zhes ci nus bzlas pas/ sngags phreng las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ phyi nang snod bcud thams cad dang*/ phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs rnams la phog /de rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs/ ro bcud dwangs ma thams cad spyan drangs/ ye shes ḍā ki'i sku la thim/ de las 'od zer 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa babs/ bdag gi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas mar zhugs/ lus thams cad mer khengs/ tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib (312)nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad sangs kyis dag /'chi med dwangs ma gsum ldan mchog gi sprul sku bla ma 'grub par byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ mthar/ gong ltar phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod 'bul/ 'ja' lus sku brnyes mi shigs pa'i// dwangs ma lhan skyes sgyu ma'i sku// 'od gsal bde chen longs spyod rdzogs// su kha sid+dhi khyed rang mkhyen// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ mdun bskyed bla ma ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro gdan khri dang bcas pa 'od du ltems se zhu/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i lus ngag yid gsum la sku gsung thugs gnyis su med par thim pas/ dbang bzhi stan thog gcig tu thob/ gnas skabs bzhi'i sgrib pa dag cing mthar thugs sku bzhi'i go 'phang thob par bsams la rig pa chos nyid bya rtsol bral ba'i ngang du ci gnas su bzhag

/mthar zung 'jug gi skur ldangs la bsngo smon bya'o// spyir ye shes mkha' 'gro su kha'i chos skor la/ bdag med ma'i nang khrid dang*/ phag mo gsang sgrub kyi skor sogs mkhas grub khyung po nyid las byon pa dang*/ phyis gnyan ston chen po la dngos su stsal ba'i bskyed rim gzer gsum/ lte ba sprul 'khor sogs gdams ngag shin tu zab cing 'dril ba'i smar chos 'ga' zhig gi nang nas/ deng sang yig rnying phal cher zhig gi lung rgyun dang khrid brgya'i nang tshan tsam las cher mi bzhugs kyang*/ rtsa ba ni chos drug 'di dang phyag chen dag pa ye shes gnyis po yin zhing*/ mkhas grub khyung pos dka' chen spyad pa'i gces nor gser chos 'di nyid chad du phongs pas phyis 'byon blo bzang ngag gis rgyun bskyang ba dang*/ 'di'i byin rlabs thob nas nyams len gyi rtsa ba 'di tsam la 'bad pas kyang grub pa gnyis bde blag tu brnyes par 'gyur ba ni ye shes (313)ḍā ki'i tha tshig gi nges pa'o// dad brtson dam tshig ldan pa yis// lo'am zla ba drug nyid du// rdo rje 'chang dngos 'grub byed pa// thabs lam snying po yid bzhin nor// grags phyir ma yin chos tshul 'di/ 'phel zhing gnas phyir ci nus su// bshad pa'i dge bas bdag gzhan kun// bde chen dngos grub mchog brnyes shog /ces pa'ang thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po mañdzu gho ṣa'i zhal snga nas chos tshul 'di snying gi thig ler nod pa'i tshe/ mkhyen rab kyi mnga' bdag rje dbon blo gros bzang po'i thugs bzhed kyis rkyen byas te/ bla ma'i zhal lung zin thun gyi tshul du yon tan rgya mtshos dpal spungs kyi gdan sar bris shing*/ yig rnying rnams kyi dgongs don kyang tshang bar 'dus gsal gyi khul du spel ba bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs par gyur cig /dge legs 'phel/// /(314)
